howItWorksSteps.title: You Order
howItWorksSteps.copy: Choose your bag, color and options online or via our atelier.

howItWorksSteps.title: Handcrafted in Morocco
howItWorksSteps.copy: Your piece is cut, stitched and finished by hand in our workshop.

howItWorksSteps.title: Shipped to Your Door
howItWorksSteps.copy: Packed with care and shipped with tracking, wherever you are.

beforeYouOrderNotes.title: Leather Varies Naturally
beforeYouOrderNotes.copy: Natural leather contains variations in grain, tone and texture. No two hides — and no two bags — are ever perfectly identical.

beforeYouOrderNotes.title: Handmade Means Unique
beforeYouOrderNotes.copy: Minor differences in stitching and finishing are the signature of handcraftsmanship, not a flaw.

beforeYouOrderNotes.title: Color May Vary From Photography
beforeYouOrderNotes.copy: Screen settings and the natural character of leather can cause subtle differences from the photos shown.

trustListItems.title: Individually inspected
trustListItems.copy: Every piece checked by hand before dispatch

trustListItems.title: Arrives damaged?
trustListItems.copy: We replace it, no questions asked

shippingPage.processingTimeBody: In-stock pieces ship within 1–3 business days. Made-to-order and custom pieces are handcrafted first — {productionTime}. The exact estimate is shown on each product page.
shippingPage.ratesFinalizing: Shipping rates are being finalized — check back soon, or contact us for a destination estimate.
shippingPage.trackingBody: You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships. Delivery time depends on destination — see the estimates above.

shippingPage.adminNote: Rates and regions above are managed in Store Admin → Shipping and should be reviewed against your business's actual shipping carriers before launch.
